scripts.build:app: for src in apps/*/app.ts; do app=$(basename $(dirname "$src")); cargo run -p micro-compiler --bin microc -- "$src" "apps/$app/dist/$app.mbc" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:web:app: npm run build:app && mkdir -p products/micro-web-player/public/apps && cp apps/counter/dist/counter.mbc apps/shell/dist/shell.mbc products/micro-web-player/public/apps/
scripts.build:web: npm run build:web:app && npm run build:web:wasm && vite build products/micro-web-player
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:web:app && npm run build:web:wasm && vite products/micro-web-player --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.demo: npm run build:app && cargo run -p micro-host-sdl --features native -- --os apps/shell/dist/shell.mbc apps/counter/dist/counter.mbc
scripts.test:web: npm run test:web:unit && npm run build:web && playwright test
